headline: A federal law renames a post office in Montclair, California, after Paul Eaton.
what_it_does: This law names a U.S. Postal Service building at 5186 Benito Street in Montclair, California, the Paul Eaton Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the facility. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or how the building operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 3, 2020, and the renaming took effect on that date.
